english_draft: Meta Platforms reported second quarter 2026 results on July 29, 2026. Revenue for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 was USD 60.801 billion, up 28% year over year. Operating income was USD 18.775 billion, down 8% year over year. Operating margin was 31%, compared with 43% a year earlier. Diluted EPS was USD 6.18. Costs and expenses were USD 42.026 billion. This amount included USD 2.40 billion of legal charges and USD 1.18 billion of severance from a May 2026 headcount reduction. Family daily active people averaged 3.60 billion in June 2026. Ad impressions grew 14% year over year. Average ad price grew 12% year over year. Capital expenditure including finance leases was USD 31.08 billion. The company provided a revenue outlook for the third quarter of 2026 of USD 61 billion to USD 64 billion. This preview is a historical reconstruction. It uses only information available before July 29, 2026. It was not written before the third quarter earnings release. The third quarter earnings date is October 21, 2026. The key questions are as follows. First, will third quarter revenue growth remain above 25% given the company guidance range? Second, will operating margin recover from the second quarter level after legal charges and severance? Third, will capital expenditure keep rising compared with the first half level? For the third quarter, the positive surprise would be revenue above USD 64 billion. The negative surprise would be revenue below USD 61 billion or margin pressure from higher costs. The verification points are actual third quarter revenue, operating margin, capital expenditure, and management commentary on AI investment and ad demand. The base for comparison is the second quarter of 2026 results. The prior quarter revenue was USD 60.801 billion. The prior quarter operating margin was 31%. The prior quarter capital expenditure was USD 31.08 billion. The third quarter revenue guidance implies a slowdown from the second quarter growth rate. The market may focus on whether the company can sustain double-digit ad price growth. The main uncertainty is whether legal charges continue and whether severance is fully completed. The analysis will compare actual results with the company guidance and the market expectations available at the time. If actual revenue is near the top of the range, that would confirm strong ad demand. If actual revenue is near the bottom, that would suggest deceleration. The next quarter focus will be on 2027 outlook, AI capex plans, and user growth.
